mathematics.assertion_tested: Over the function field K of X_1(13) (Tate normal form, F = numerator of x(6P)-x(7P)): det A_{4,2} = 0 in K, rank A_{4,2} = 5, A_{4,1} has a nonzero 4x4 minor, det A_{m,2} != 0 for m = 2,3,5,6; x(kP) have denominators only c, b-c, b-c^2-c and integral numerators; F divides the primitive integral numerator of det A_{4,2} over Z; denominators meet F only at c = 0; exceptional loci of the generic statements consist of cusps (m=2), j=0 points (m=3; m=4 at d=1) and j=1728 points (m=5,6).
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q(b,c) and Z[b,c] exact (PARI); number fields for exceptional points; F_p model check with src/ec.py
